mapper.sql: select grant_id, teacher_user_id, teacher_name, student_user_id, student_name, course_name, grant_preset, grant_perms, status, expires_at, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from edu_teacher_student_grant
mapper.select: select distinct course_name from edu_teacher_student_grant where student_user_id = #{studentUserId} and status = '0' and (expires_at is null or expires_at >= now()) and ifnull(course_name, '') <> '' order by course_name asc
where course_name = #{courseName} and status = '0' and (expires_at is null or expires_at >= now()) order by grant_id desc
